latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of stableops-lifi-treasury for policy-driven treasury management.
- Enables USDC deployment from team, DAO, or builder treasuries into LI.FI Earn vaults under explicit policy limits.
- Supports policy checks including reserve target, max per execution, allowed chains, risk level, and minimum TVL.
- Prepares Composer deposit and generates receipt-token execution reports with plain-language explanations.
- Prioritizes treasury rules and compliance before yield considerations.
